issue.title: Commit finalizer stops failing agents whose work actually landed
issue.description: An agent whose work is committed and pushed is never marked FAILED by the commit finalizer's discarded-work guard. Commit provenance survives conflict resolution, the finalizer decides attribution from evidence the run itself owns rather than from commit-message footers alone, and a concurrent agent's activity in a shared clone can no longer be misread as this agent discarding its work.

issue.title: Make the SASE commit footer survive conflict resolution
issue.description: restamp: verify and re-stamp the run's SASE_* provenance footer onto HEAD during `sase stitch create --resume`, before the push, so a hand-resolved rebase conflict can no longer land the run's own commit unattributed.

issue.title: Record a run-owned commit ledger
issue.description: ledger: persist every commit SHA this run created or finalized into the agent artifacts directory, including the resume path that currently records a null result, so later stages have positive proof of what the run committed.

issue.title: Decide attribution from run-owned evidence
issue.description: guard: teach the discarded-work guard to consult the run-owned commit ledger before declaring a discard, so a commit the run provably created counts as attributable even when its footer is missing.

issue.title: Stop blaming an agent for concurrent activity in shared clones
issue.description: shared: classify foreign-agent and already-published transitions in machine-wide clones as races rather than discards, extending the exemption beyond sdd-kind repos and putting the relaxation behind a feature flag.

issue.title: Actionable diagnostics and regression coverage
issue.description: hardening: replace the guard's dead-end failure text with an operator-actionable diagnostic, add end-to-end regressions reproducing both failure clusters, and refresh the affected docs.
